generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Azure Dynamics conversion of the Ford Transit Connect: 28 kWh Johnson Controls-Saft lithium-ion pack (16 modules, 192 cells), 3.3 kW Brusa on-board charger on J1772, no DC fast charging; EPA range 56 mi (90 km). Built Dec 2010-Mar 2012, ended by Azure's bankruptcy (Mar 2012). Commercial van/wagon sold mainly to fleets. EPA MY2012 only. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Azure_Dynamics ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Azure_Transit_Connect_Electric ; https://www.autoblog.com/2010/12/07/ford-transit-connect-gets-delivered-in-short-order-by-azure-dyna/
